# ECRS

> ECRS (Eastern Cooperative Recreation School) is an intergenerational organization providing creative and engaging activities that are fun, develop leadership, and build community. Come to Play. Play to Learn.

ECRS events are open to all ages and all levels of experience. Programs include folk dance, music, drama, games, and crafts, led by participants for one another. Events are held at retreat centers and community venues in Pennsylvania, New York, New Jersey, and Delaware, and range from one-day Fun Days to multi-day residential weekends and the annual Winter Adventure. Newcomers receive free tuition at their first multi-day event. The mailing address is 323 Race St, Philadelphia, PA 19106.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ecrs.org/): Overview of ECRS, its mission, and upcoming events.
- [Events](https://ecrs.org/events): Upcoming events with registration, plus past events.
- [About](https://ecrs.org/about): Who ECRS is, its values, and its history.
- [Our People](https://ecrs.org/our-people): The board, staff, and class leaders.
- [Gallery](https://ecrs.org/gallery): Photos from ECRS events.
- [Membership](https://ecrs.org/membership): Become a member for event discounts and a say in the direction of ECRS.
- [Activities](https://ecrs.org/activities): A library of games, dances, and songs with instructions for leading them.
- [Connections](https://ecrs.org/connections): Related organizations and resources.
- [Join the mailing list](https://ecrs.org/join-email-list): Get news about upcoming events by email.
- [Contact](https://ecrs.org/contact): Send a question or message to ECRS.
- [Donate](https://ecrs.org/donate): Support ECRS with a tax-deductible donation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ecrs.org/privacy): How ECRS handles personal data.

## Event data

Each event page has a plain-text version at the same address with `.txt` added, and a calendar file with `.ics` added, for example https://ecrs.org/events/2026-winter-adventure.txt.

## Feeds

- [Sitemap](https://ecrs.org/sitemap-index.xml): Every public page.
